plan.title: Fitness Programme Impact Report
plan.subtitle: Summary of participant growth and performance improvements from baseline to endline

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Avg Height Gain (cm)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm") AS n FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Weight Gain (kg)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Weight kg" - b."Weight kg") AS n FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS n FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT b."Gender" AS gender, AVG(e."Sit ups") AS avg_sit_ups FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Shuttle Run Speed Distribution
panels.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT 'Baseline' AS stage, "Shuttle run sec" AS val FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT 'Endline' AS stage, "Shuttle run sec" AS val FROM endline) SELECT stage, AVG(val) AS avg_time FROM stats GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY stage

panels.title: Top 10 Locations by Participation
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS count FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This programme engaged {{p1}} children across multiple locations, providing a comprehensive fitness assessment at both the start and end of the intervention period. The data reveals significant physical development, with participants showing an average height increase of {{p2}} cm and a weight gain of {{p3}} kg, indicating healthy growth trajectories.

Performance metrics highlight improved agility and strength. On average, children reduced their shuttle run times by {{p4}} seconds, demonstrating enhanced speed and endurance. Additionally, the gender breakdown in sit-ups shows varying levels of core strength development, with males and females achieving different averages as detailed in the bar chart.

The line chart illustrates the overall shift in shuttle run performance, confirming that the majority of participants improved their times from baseline to endline. Finally, the table identifies the top 10 locations with the highest participation rates, helping to understand the geographical reach and engagement density of the programme.
